conclusion: The October 17 Orca integration and large-project benchmarks remain historical at their original anchors. Current support changes additionally cover independently positioned, stepped bottom contacts, root continuations and native extrusion-height modulation. Those changes are validated by the separately source-bound October 25 root-continuity evidence; they do not establish a new upstream merge, remote-ref state, GUI interaction result or current large-project performance benchmark.
scope: Reviewed source and native Release acceptance on 2026-10-25; historical upstream/performance claims retain their original scope. No hardware print or universal model guarantee.

verification.method: Manual source and scope review, full organic/tree-bridge and clearance regressions, two unmodified Release CLI exports, per-plane geometry and actual extrusion interval checks.
verification.summary: Relocating a bottom contact without extending its original root leaves a local vertical void. Source-grid collision masks can erase a legal independently sliced root. A footprint crossing model steps requires separate visible surface contacts; succeeding paths require native height modulation over those contacts, including ordered hollow-wall collections.
